metadata.description: Convert Word/PDF to Markdown in Cursor with bundled paradocs-convert MCP, rules, and paragon-tech-docs skill. Prerequisites: Paragon team sign-in with Team Marketplace access; Python 3.10+ with venv; network on first convert only (PyPI). Optional: PARADOCS_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR. Remediation: install Python 3.10+, reopen Cursor; Linux python3-venv; allow PyPI once if pip fails; enable from Team Marketplace, Reload Window, check paradocs-convert Connected. No separate paradocs.py install.

plugins.name: paradocs
plugins.description: Convert Word/PDF to Markdown in Cursor with bundled paradocs-convert MCP, rules, and paragon-tech-docs skill. Prerequisites: signed into Paragon team with Team Marketplace access; Python 3.10+ with venv; network on first convert only (PyPI for .paradocs-venv). Optional: Configure PARADOCS_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR. If Python is missing or too old, install 3.10+ and reopen Cursor; Linux needs python3-venv; allow PyPI once if pip fails; enable ParaDOCS from Team Marketplace, Reload Window, check paradocs-convert Connected. Engine is bundled; do not install paradocs.py separately.
